Subject: Thanks for joining the webinar — quick demo to see Redwood in your stack

Hi Sam —

Thanks for joining our "Serving LLMs in Production" webinar yesterday — really glad you could make it. A few attendees mentioned they wanted to see a quick, 30-minute walkthrough of how Redwood handles dedicated inference, routing policies, and cost controls.

If you and Priya are open to it, I can set up a short demo next week focused on:
- Model routing and fallbacks (useful for multi-region setups)
- Cost controls: batching, caching, quantization recommendations
- A quick walkthrough of the Dedicated offering + SLA questions

Proposed slots (all PST):
- Tue 11/23 10:00–10:30am
- Wed 11/24 2:00–2:30pm
- Thu 11/25 11:00–11:30am

I’ve attached the webinar deck and a one-pager for reference. If none of those times work, tell me a couple windows that do and I’ll coordinate with Laura to lock it in.

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwoodinference.com
